_doc: Mau ho so trang. Chep file nay thanh <ten-trang>.json roi sua.
File bat dau bang _ bi bo qua, nen file nay khong bao gio duoc dung that.
Chi can dien nhung truong ma auto-nhan-dang lam SAI. De trong nghia la
dung mac dinh trong code - phan lon trang khong can dien gi ngoai match.
Thu tu uu tien:  .env  >  ho so nay  >  mac dinh trong code.
_match: Ten mien. Khop ca mien phu: 'vidu.com' khop luon 'a.vidu.com'.
_episodeSelector: CSS selector cua cac muc trong muc luc tap.
De trong = tu nhan dang bang episodeRe, thuong la du.
_episodeRe: Regex nhan mot dong co phai ten tap khong, khop tu dau chuoi.
De trong = dung mac dinh, nhan duoc: E1.  Ep 2 -  Episode 3:  Tap 4.  EP-36
Chi sua neu trang danh so kieu khac han, vd 'Phan 1 / 12'.
_seriesTitleSelector: Noi chua ten tac pham. De trong = thu aria-label roi den h1.
_playSelector: Nut Play. De trong = tu goi .play() tren the <video>.
_waitMs: Cho toi da bao lau moi tap (ms). 0 = dung mac dinh 25000.
_stopAfterFails: May tap lien tiep khong phat duoc thi coi la het phan mien phi va dung.
0 = dung mac dinh 3. Dat rat lon neu trang khong co noi dung tra phi.
